item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00140","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C15","C04","C12"],"selected_candidate_label":"C15","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C15 concerns the same Officer Personnel Act provisions governing retirement of Regular Army colonels and uses the same suspension-period machinery, including June 30, 1957 and discretionary retention by the Secretary of the Army. It therefore supplies a concrete substantive and drafting template for the child. C04 and C12 share the statutory suspension formula but address Marine Corps promotion requirements rather than colonel retirement.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The operation of those provisions of paragraph 3, subsection (d), section 514 of the Officer Personnel Act of 1947 which are applicable to the mandatory retirement of colonels of the Regular Army is hereby suspended","parent_excerpt":"Suspension of the Operation of Certain Provisions of the Officer Personnel Act of 1947 Applicable to the Retirement of Colonels of the Regular Army and the Regular Air Force","explanation":"Both directives suspend provisions of the same act applicable to the retirement of Regular Army colonels."},{"child_excerpt":"until termination of the emergency proclaimed by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of December 16, 1950, or until June 30, 1957, or until a date specified by the Secretary of the Army, whichever is earliest","parent_excerpt":"or until September 30, 1954, whichever is earlier (except that the Secretary of the Army may in his discretion retain not more than twenty of those officers selected for retention under the authority hereof until June 30, 1957, or such earlier dates as he may deem appropriate)","explanation":"The child reuses the parent's alternative termination dates and June 30, 1957 endpoint while adapting the Secretary's discretionary-retention mechanism."},{"child_excerpt":"whom the Secretary of the Army, in his discretion, selects for retention on the active list in the public interest","parent_excerpt":"the Secretary of the Army may in his discretion retain not more than twenty of those officers selected for retention under the authority hereof","explanation":"Both give the Secretary of the Army discretionary authority to select affected colonels for continued active service."}]}
